title: ChatGPT custom instructions for business that end generic answers
description: Set up ChatGPT custom instructions for business, plus projects in ChatGPT and Claude and Gems in Gemini, with a one-page brand file template and prompts.
lede: Your AI gives generic answers because it doesn't know your business. ChatGPT custom instructions for business, along with projects in ChatGPT and Claude, solve that problem. Write one page describing your offer, buyer, voice, proof and limits, then store it where your AI reads it every time.
